source_rows.article: All hydrogenated, partially hydrogenated, interesterified vegetable oils and fats such as vanaspati, table margarine, bakery and industrial margarine, bakery shortening, fat spread and partially hydrogenated margarine, bakery shortening, fat spread and partially hydrogenated soyabean oil

records.regulatory_interpretation: FoSCoS corresponding dairy categories carry associated contaminant safety standards, notwithstanding that the analogue is not legally milk.
requires: Confirm actual analogue and its corresponding licensed FoSCoS dairy food category, not whether the analogue is ordinary milk.
Determine corresponding current FSSAI finished-food contaminant article for the specific analogue matrix and process.
Check complete batch composition, testing basis and operative amendments before assigning any numerical limit.
records.exclude: FSSAI FAQ Q7 makes corresponding dairy-category contaminant safety standards applicable; however an analogue is not itself ordinary milk. Never automatically copy milk-only numeric limits or declare a safety-standard exemption.

requires: Verify INS 334 and CAS 87-69-4 L(+) stereochemistry using an authentic product specification and certificate, not the ambiguous catalogue label.
Compare FSSR 3.2.10(4) arsenic and lead identity-purity limits separately to Version IX source references.
Assess current amendments and the tested lot before any compliance decision.
records.exclude: L(+) FSSAI source limits are not automatically applicable to D(-), DL/racemic or optically unspecified tartaric acid.

requires: Determine actual milk/mixed/vegetable fat spread subtype, FSSR fat 40–80% and legal applicability of any separate Minarine identity.
Document actual hydrogenation/partial hydrogenation/interesterification process to qualify for Version IX Nickel article.
Establish sample matrix, other contaminants and the finished-product laboratory basis.
records.exclude: Do not equate generic 40–80% FSSR Fat Spread with Minarine Low Fat Spread or assign Nickel without an applicable hydrogenation/interesterification condition.
